notes.title: Adding a ball color selection
notes.content:
The ability to select a primary and secondary color has been added. You can change all this by selecting the appropriate item in the main menu of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39703345/74994ec0f3d07a4e5fc22e8ddc89dabe49f16cf3.png[/img]

You can send your ideas and suggestions to the discussion or to the discord channel - https://discord.gg/s9uBz4qHFZ

notes.title: Error correction
notes.content:
1) Fixed the fullscreen mode setting function
2) Slightly changed physics
If you find any error, please write to the discussion or to the discord channel - https://discord.gg/7nSaNh6yca

notes.title: Fixes for the DXGI_ERROR_INVALID_CALL error
notes.content:
The full-screen mode feature that causes this error is temporarily disabled.
If you encounter the "LowLevelFatalError [File:Unknown] [Line: 836] 
Rendering thread exception:
LowLevelFatalError [File:Unknown] [Line: 249] 
Result failed 
 at D:/Build/++UE4/Sync/Engine/Source/Runtime/Windows/D3D11RHI/Private/D3D11Viewport.cpp:368 
 with error DXGI_ERROR_INVALID_CALL" error, then you need to delete the Config folder at the path AppData\Local\Ball\Saved\

UPD: You can switch between full-screen mode and windowed mode using the Alt + Enter key combination

notes.title: Drop items for the time spent in the game.
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with dropping items. Now everything is working properly, download the latest version of the game. 
Offer your options of subjects in the discussion or in the discord - https://discord.gg/fqa98B5

notes.title: Bug fixes and adding new features
notes.content:
1. Added music to the main menu
2. Added an exit button to the pause menu.
3. Fixed a bug with dropping items(need feedback from players)

UPD: Drop items are not available. We are trying to solve this problem. Sorry for the inconvenience.
